introduction: North Carolina LIEAP provides one annual vendor payment toward eligible heating costs. County DSS handles applications.
description: North Carolina LIEAP provides one annual vendor payment toward eligible heating costs. County DSS handles applications.

sections.who: Income and household eligibility rules apply, including responsibility for heating costs. Early intake has specific older-age or disability-service conditions.
sections.get: The payment goes to the heating vendor. It is separate from crisis assistance.
sections.docs:
• Identity and address proof.
  • Income and resource evidence.
  • Heating bills and requested eligibility records.
sections.apply:
1. Check your window

    Use LIEAP guidance. December intake serves listed priority households; others apply January–March.

  2. Apply

    Use ePASS or county DSS and confirm current local dates.

  3. Provide records

    Respond to the worker’s verification requests.
sections.after: Ask about CIP if a health-related heating emergency develops.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using LIEAP intake and documents. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is every disabled household eligible for December intake?
The state specifies disability-benefit and aging-services conditions.
